How do I start a return or an exchange?
You’re totally fine to get the ball rolling on a return, here’s how:
UK returns: Use the online portal at the linked courier site, search for “Chillys”, fill in your details, and choose your return method.
Outside the UK: Post your unused item to the Bedford warehouse returns address shown on your despatch note, ideally with a tracked/signed service.
We accept returns within 30 days of delivery, items must be unused and in saleable condition, and you’ll need proof of purchase. Return postage is paid by you, as we don’t offer free returns.
For bundles, you’ll need to return the entire bundle with all items intact and unused—individual parts can’t be returned on their own.
If your item is damaged or faulty, don’t send it back; instead, hold onto it and contact our Customer Service Team via the support widget so we can help without you paying return postage.
